protocol: Only first-frame reference rectangle initializes each tracker. Subsequent reference masks/boxes are scored after prediction and never passed to the tracker.
Candidate may be developed on blackswan only. Freeze its implementation commit before fetching/evaluating the other two sequences. No retuning after evaluation results.

The first frame is disclosed initialization and excluded from scored predictions. All remaining selected frames count, including lost observations as IoU zero. No reset on failure or selective frame removal.
The rectangle is derived from the nonzero extent of objectId in the published mask; this is box tracking, not official DAVIS mask J/F scoring.

Report mean IoU, fraction of frames with IoU>=0.5, low-overlap visible predictions (IoU<0.1), losses, and per-frame wall-clock latency. Original capture FPS is not asserted; source frame ordinals are retained.
Identity scores refer to the dataset's annotated object, not face/name identity. Initial human-guided annotation is disclosed.
Evaluation is a small public development/validation subset, not an official benchmark score or proof of general real-world accuracy.
baseline: Edition022 PixelTracker RGB8x8, anchor and ambiguity rejection; no tuning against evaluation sequences
